name: Multi Recipient Router
helpText:
Multi Recipient Router

The router will allow the payload to be sent conditionally to zero or many routes e.g. the logic could send the payload to routeA AND routeB.
allowableProperties_comment: Note that the order of properties in this file dictates the order displayed on screen, unless propertyDisplayOrder is set, which will be used as the primary key

componentName.helpText: The name of the component as displayed on diagrams. The name should be unique for the flow. The name will be used internally to reflect the bean created.

userImplementedClassName.helpText: The name of the class that contain the logic to decide which route a payload will be delivered to, the IDE will create a template for this class, the user  must provide the implementation.
userImplementedClassName.validationMessage: Provide a valid java classname for the router e.g. starting with upper case, followed by number/characters etc.

configuration.helpText: Provide the bean type that contains bespoke configurations for this component.
configuration.validationMessage: Provide a java classname for the Configuration bean.

configuredResource.helpText: Default(False). Allow the Configuration to be exposed in the Ikasan console.

configurationId.helpText: By default, the configuration ID = modulename + flowname + componentName + componentType. There are times when you may wish to override this i.e. if you want multiple flows to share the same configration or you have changed a flow name but don't want to update properties that may have already been stored in the override properties database.

fromType.helpText: The type of data we expect to come into the converter. This can be any Java class.
fromType.validationMessage: Provide a fully qualified Java class name to be used as the type for the input to the converter.

routeNames.helpText: A comma-separated list of route names your router logic (see the generated class) selects from per message - it can choose none, one, or many of them.
routeNames.validationMessage: Provide a comma-separated list of route names (duplicates will be ignored).
